title: Cold call connects
speaker: system
trigger: The call connects and someone picks up
responseText: Hey, quick check, is this the receptionist or the manager?
objective: Determine who answered the phone

title: Receptionist
speaker: system
trigger: They confirm they're the receptionist / front desk
responseText: Awesome, you're exactly who I wanted. Mind if I ask you something quick?
objective: Get buy-in before asking the research question

title: Manager / Owner
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: The person who answered says they're the owner or manager
responseText: Oh perfect, actually hoping to catch you directly.
objective: Move straight into decision-maker mode

title: Someone else
speaker: system
trigger: Not clearly reception or management (e.g. a nurse or assistant)
responseText: No worries — who handles patient enquiries and bookings there, or who should I be speaking to?
objective: Identify the right person to route the call to

title: Unknown / unclear
speaker: system

responseText: Sorry, quick check — is this reception, or the practice manager?
objective: Clarify who's on the line before continuing

title: They say sure / okay
speaker: receptionist
trigger: They agree to answer a quick question
responseText: Perfect. So I'm a student doing some research, just wondering — do you guys use any software to track your clients, or pen and paper still?
objective: Find out what system (if any) the practice uses

title: They use software
speaker: receptionist
trigger: They say they use a system (e.g. Dentally, SOE, R4, iSmile)
responseText: Oh nice, which one?

title: They name the software
speaker: receptionist

responseText: And how do you find it? Anything you like or dislike about it?

title: They like it

title: They mention something they'd change

title: They can't think of anything

objective: Acknowledge the pain and bridge to positioning

title: They don't know

objective: Route to whoever can answer

title: They don't know

objective: Clarify whether to keep discovering here or route onward

title: Continue

title: Continue
speaker: receptionist

responseText: So what are you guys currently using?
objective: Return to system discovery

responseText: Absolutely, who'd be the best person to speak to?
objective: Capture: name, position, best time to call, direct number
notes: Get all four details before ending — name, position, best time, direct number.

title: Details captured

objective: Wrap up the call and log a follow-up

objective: Capture the right email address

responseText: Which system's that?
objective: Identify the specific system

trigger: They've named the system

objective: Surface pain in the current system

objective: Understand the manual process

speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They give a rough volume or time estimate

trigger: They admit no one follows up on missed bookings

speaker: decision_maker

title: Continue

trigger: Ready to ask about bookings
responseText: And bookings — all online, or still a lot of back and forth on the phone?
objective: Understand the booking process

title: Mostly manual / phone

title: Mostly online
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: Bookings are already mostly online

title: Continue

title: Already handled

trigger: Reactivation is already automated or actively managed
responseText: That's great, that's covered. Even so, most practices still have gaps somewhere in the middle — sounds like you've got less than most though. Can I quickly show you what we built for you?

title: Continue
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: Ready to present the solution
responseText: So basically what we've built follows up with every enquiry, every patient who hasn't booked back in, handles reactivation for that dormant list, syncs straight into your calendar. Nothing falls through, and nobody has to manually chase it.
objective: Present the solution, tied directly to the specific pain they just described

title: Continue
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: Ready to introduce the prepared custom asset and ask for the meeting
responseText: And actually, since I was planning this call, had my team put something together specific for your practice already. I'd rather just show you than explain it, makes way more sense. Got 15 minutes this week for a quick screen-share?
objective: Introduce the prepared custom asset and pivot to booking a discovery call

title: What does it cost?
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They ask about price before agreeing to anything

objective: Defer pricing until value is shown, without dodging the question

title: Not a good time / too busy
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They say now/this week is too busy

title: We're happy with what we've got
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They say they're happy with their current setup
responseText: That's great to hear — and genuinely, if it's covering everything you told me, this might not even be relevant. But given what you mentioned earlier, worth 15 minutes just to compare — worst case it confirms you're already sorted.

title: Just send something over
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They ask you to just email something instead of meeting

objective: Push back once on email-only, then accommodate if they insist

title: They still insist on email
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They insist on email over a call
responseText: No problem at all — what's the best email? I'll follow up with a quick call after you've had a look.
objective: Capture email and set a follow-up call time

title: Let me think about it
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They want to think it over or discuss with a partner first

objective: Reframe the meeting as input to their decision, not a decision itself

title: Someone else is involved
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They say a business partner or someone else needs to be involved

title: They agree to include them

trigger: They agree to loop the other decision-maker in

title: Continue

objective: Fall back to a callback if they won't book live

title: Continue
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: Ready to lock in a callback time
responseText: No problem — what's generally good for a call back?
objective: Lock in a callback window

title: Yes, let's do it
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They agree to a discovery call / screen-share
responseText: Great — Thursday afternoon work, or is there a better time in the week?
objective: Lock in a specific day/time for the discovery call

title: Time confirmed
speaker: decision_maker
trigger: They confirm a day/time for the discovery call
responseText: Perfect, I'll send a calendar invite over now — looking forward to it.
objective: Confirm and close: discovery call booked
